replacements.p1-r0: Small and Medium Enterprise Technology Development (R&D) Support Business R&D Plan
replacements.p1-r2: Development of a RAG-based Business-specific Real-time Multilingual Translation AI Solution Global Sales, Consultation, Interpretation, and Document Automation Integrated Platform for Export Revenue Innovation for SMEs
replacements.p1-r4: Implement a business-specific AI model by developing a RAG-based multilingual translation model that has learned unique product names, technical specifications, and prices for each company, and a real-time streaming interpretation (in more than 8 languages) model within seconds delay for export tasks. Develop an agent type for export document automation throughout the entire export cycle, including quotes and product pages. Build a platform that integrates unique regulatory certification formatting modules such as eCTD, KC, CE, and FCC to eliminate barriers to global entry for SMEs and realize revenue innovation.
replacements.p1-r6: Construct an overwhelming entry barrier by fine-tuning domain-specific AI using an exclusive corpus of 1.1 million sentence pairs of business-specific 600 thousand regulatory certifications and 500 thousand. [AI Model Upgrading] Combine RAG technology that injects company-specific knowledge into hybrid language models based on NLLB/EXAONE to reduce hallucination phenomena by 70%. [InfiniSST and Whisper-based Technology] Secure simultaneous interpretation performance within a delay of seconds using proven AI platforms. [SaaS Platform Commercialization] Utilize the infrastructure of validated AI platforms (Oz-i) by the lead institution to develop a cloud-based SaaS web-mobile-API integrated environment that allows companies to link and use their data within 3 days without IT personnel.
replacements.p2-r0:
[Lead] PCN Co., Ltd. (Platform/Commercialization Lead): An AI company with 25 years of experience (sales of 27 billion) owning the Oz-i AI platform and various R&D business know-how, guarantees the establishment of a SaaS platform, API integration, and cloud infrastructure commercialization.
[Co-joint ①] StunningBox Co., Ltd. (AI Model/Data Lead): An AI translation data company with 15 years of specialized data set accumulation, responsible for AI translation fine-tuning and providing the core asset, exclusive corpus, and multi-agent regulatory certification formatting technology.
[Co-joint ②] 3 demand companies (Field Verification): Sunlight IlluCom (automobile parts), Genuine Grip (special shoes), and Gray Whale (K-Beauty), actual export top award-winning companies, provide verification data per industry and quantitatively verify the introduction effect through A/B testing.
replacements.p2-r2:
[Economic and Industrial Impact] Increase demand companies' export order rate by over 20%, and drastically reduce the regulatory certification document processing period from the existing 4-8 weeks to 1-2 weeks. After 5 years of commercialization, create sales of 22 billion KRW (68 billion KRW cumulative over 5 years), generate 51 new jobs, and plan to distribute to over 500 SMEs through AI vouchers and KOTRA linkage. Achieve an export substitution effect worth 44 billion KRW cumulative over 5 years.
[Acquisition of World-class Technology] Achieve a translation accuracy of BLEU 65 or higher, voice interpretation delay of 2 seconds or less, and document structure preservation rate (TEDS) of 70% or more to dominate the B2B domain-specific translation market that global big tech (Google, DeepL) could not resolve.

replacements.p4-r75: 1) Background and necessity of business promotion
replacements.p4-r77: Export SMEs face complex barriers in overseas business due to translations that do not reflect the company-specific context, interpreting structures unfit for real-time consultations, and high-cost, long-term regulatory certification document responses. Therefore, beyond simple translation functions, an AI platform specialized in domain connecting the entire export task lifecycle based on company data and technical terminology is needed.
